versions.changelog:
Initial release of pageskim

- Generates .llm.md (and optional .llm.json) files for each site page, enabling AI agents to read sites using 10–50x fewer tokens.
- Detects popular static site generators (Astro, Next.js, Hugo, Jekyll, or plain HTML) and auto-selects output folders and build commands.
- Adds a site index at /.well-known/pageskim.json for agent discovery.
- Integrates with site build and CI processes to keep skim files up-to-date.
- Validates generated files to ensure quality and reports token savings to the user.
- Recommends non-intrusive deployment: no mandatory dependency or version lock-in.
